title: Drownings at unguarded beaches
summary: At the latest meeting, the ocean safety chief said Maui has had 14 drownings this year, all at unguarded beaches. Roving patrols were added in each district during the recent hurricane, and the junior lifeguard program grew to about 450 youths from 300 in 2025, though up to 600 applied. In November 2025 the item was deferred, and the council chair asked for a prioritized plan and specific funding requests.
